If you want data or code for a specific paper and cannot find it, ask me directly
at [mesfin.genie@newcastle.edu.au](mailto:mesfin.genie@newcastle.edu.au). Some
datasets carry ethics or partner restrictions I cannot lift, but I can usually say
what is possible.
